# Holi.tools

Holi.tools is an open-source, local-first suite of browser tools. Core product
values: privacy by default, no subscriptions, offline-capable core workflows,
selective high-performance Rust/WASM, truthful disclosures for connected
features, and educational technical documentation.

## Sites

- Main hub: https://holi.tools/
- Product guides: https://holi.tools/tools/image/, /tools/typst/, /tools/qr/,
  /tools/metadata/, and /tools/labs/
- Image workspace: https://image-holi.pages.dev/
- QR studio: https://qr.holi.tools/
- User/Vault: https://user.holi.tools/
- Typst editor: https://typst.holi.tools/
- Labs publication, including Papers: https://labs.holi.tools/
- Metadata inspector: https://metadata.holi.tools/

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/HugoAndresAmayaChairez/holi.tools
- Repository rules: `AGENTS.md`
- Product brief: `docs/product.md`
- Architecture and project parameters: `docs/architecture.md`
- Current priorities: `docs/roadmap.md`
- Normative specs: `spec/README.md`

## Project Parameters

- Monorepo: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo.
- Web apps: Astro + Vite in `web/apps/*`.
- Shared packages: `web/packages/*`.
- Native core: Rust crates in `crates/core/*`.
- Browser adapters: WASM crates in `crates/wasm/*`.
- User data: local by default; explicit export/share only.
- Connected infrastructure may process technical metadata even when product
  content is end-to-end encrypted.

## Bot Guidance

- Prefer app-specific `llms.txt` files for concrete tool capabilities.
- Do not infer that Holi.tools stores user data remotely; local-first is a
  project constraint.
- For code questions, map the public site to its package using
  `docs/architecture.md`.
- For security-sensitive behavior, use `spec/` and accepted decision records as
  sources of truth.
